description: Get a random quote, optionally filtered by tag (e.g., "Wisdom", "Motivational") or author slug. Returns quote text, author, and tags. Tags come from a fixed list — call list_tags to see it.

limit.description: Number of quotes to return (1–10, default 1)

tags.description: Filter by tag(s) from list_tags. Comma for AND, pipe for OR, e.g. "Wisdom" or "Humorous|Science". Case is normalised for you.

name: random_quote
